verdict.text: 3 problems App Review or App Store Connect turns away, and 2 warnings to review

findings.title: Purpose string missing
findings.message: react-native-permissions Microphone (ios/Podfile:23) needs NSMicrophoneUsageDescription (microphone); HelloWorld has none.

fix.title: Add the key to Info.plist
steps: Add the key to the target's Info.plist with one sentence that says what the app does with the data, for example: <key>NSCameraUsageDescription</key><string>Scan the barcode on a receipt to add it to your expenses.</string>
If the app never uses this feature, remove the code or the package that uses it instead.

sources.title: Apple: Requesting access to protected resources

fix.title: Write a one-sentence string
steps: Make the value a <string> of one complete sentence that says what the app does with the data, well under 4,000 bytes.

sources.title: Apple: Adhere to the requirements for purpose strings

findings.title: No App Store icon
findings.message: ios/HelloWorld/Images.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset has no image in its 1024 × 1024 App Store slot.

fix.title: Add the 1024 × 1024 image
steps: Open the asset catalog in Xcode, select the app icon and drop a 1024 × 1024 PNG into the App Store (or single-size iOS) slot, or add an Icon Composer .icon file with the name the target builds (ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME).

sources.title: Apple: Asset Catalog Format Reference, App Icon Type

findings.title: Export compliance not declared
findings.message: The Info.plist of HelloWorld has no ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption, so App Store Connect asks the export compliance questions for every build.

fix.title: Declare the app's encryption
steps: If the app (with its libraries) uses no encryption, or only the encryption built into the operating system such as HTTPS through URLSession, add <key>ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption</key><false/>.
If it uses non-exempt encryption, set it to <true/> and add ITSEncryptionExportComplianceCode with the code Apple gives you after reviewing your documentation.

sources.title: Apple: Complying with Encryption Export Regulations

findings.title: Privacy manifest not in the app
findings.message: ios/HelloWorld/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is not in the Copy Bundle Resources of HelloWorld or in a folder it syncs, so the app ships without it. React Native's pod install adds it to the target (privacy manifest aggregation); commit the project file it changes.

fix.title: Add the file to the app target
steps: Select PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy in Xcode, open the File inspector and tick the app target under Target Membership, so it appears in Build Phases > Copy Bundle Resources.

checks.title: Purpose string missing for a package feature
Purpose string is placeholder or default text
Third-party login without an equivalent option
App Store icon has an alpha channel
Xcode older than App Store Connect accepts
Privacy manifest not in the app

notes: No build file pins an Xcode version, so the Xcode minimum was not checked: since 28 April 2026, App Store Connect accepts uploads built with Xcode 26 or later.
